fusions.name: Dabbling Snap
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Underside Strike
fusions.desc: You strike from beneath at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 30 water damage that ignores resistance, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, and leave it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Dive
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Skimming Cruise

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and it gives something back while you float

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises 8%, and from gold your mana recovers 25% faster.
